lab_questions.title: Sliding Window API Rate Limiter
lab_questions.description:
An API gateway rate limiter enforces traffic throttling on incoming API requests. A client is permitted at most R requests within any sliding time window of W seconds.

Read N (number of requests), R (max allowed requests), and W (time window size in seconds), followed by N request arrival timestamps (in strictly increasing order). For each request, output ALLOWED if the request is accepted, or DENIED if accepting it would violate the rate limit.
